texts.orig: Discussion. We thus have proved that remarkably, the can be   simulated with bounded communication; even in a bilocal scenario where Alice and Bob are (as in the quantum case) completely uncorrelated before the protocol is run, and therefore do not have any shared randomness . Our protocol provides an upper bound on the nonlocality of entanglement swapping in terms of its communication cost. It is an open question whether fewer bits of communication are actually sufficient: it might indeed be possible to simulate equatorial measurements more efficiently than with Protocol 1, or to find a more direct protocol that does not treat separately the azimuth and zenith angles of the measurement settings; more in the spirit of the Toner-Bacon simulation protocol for singlet correlations [13]. prior
